overview: Project Build Plus is a comprehensive construction management platform with scheduling, cost control, participant management, compliance, OAC meetings, and a Drawings & Documents module for viewing, uploading, and reviewing project drawings.
features: Drawings & Documents module with type tabs (Photographs, Blueprints, Architect, Construction, CAD, Engineering)
File upload with progress bar for JPG, PNG, PDF, DWG, DXF files
Review requests that trigger dashboard notifications and auto-attach to OAC Meeting addendums
OAC Meeting addendum management with edit and remove options
Share drawings with all participants and Zoom meetings
Dashboard notification center for active review requests
Advanced scheduling with crashing and resource leveling
Earned Value Management and cash flow curves
Stripe-powered subscription management with three pricing tiers
Controller account with feature locks and admin oversight
